text: MoroccoTripMap started because too many "best of Morocco" lists were clearly written by people who never left their desk. Everything here — from riads to desert camps — comes from actual time spent in more than 20 Moroccan cities, checked and rechecked so the details still hold up when you get there. It's all here in English, French, Spanish and Arabic, because a good recommendation shouldn't depend on which language you happen to speak.
